thread:
Ravi - Support: AcmeOps reporting repeated 502/504s for hosted inference since ~09:10 UTC. Customer sees P95 jump from ~600ms to 18-22s and then 5xx. Request id: r-8f3b2c. Can we triage?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: runtime/2026-03-17-canary-7 deployed at 09:04 UTC to us-west-2.

Marta - SRE: Looking now. Any chance this aligns with the canary deploy? pulling traces for r-8f3b2c...

Ravi - Support: Customer says spike began ~09:10, a few minutes after canary. They reproduced with our Python SDK. Sample snippet they ran:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="<redacted>")
resp = client.generate(prompt="hello" , timeout=30)
print(resp)
```
They also saw client retries stacking up.

Jin - Runtime: I see elevated request queue latency on a subset of gpu-pool hosts in us-west-2 between 09:06-09:18. Kernel worker logs show repeated `KV cache lock timeout` and `proto: upstream reset` around same time. Paste from node logs:
```
[09:11:02] WARN kernel: kvcache: lock wait exceeded 1000ms for model:gpt-7b-q8
[09:11:02] ERROR proxy: upstream reset id=r-8f3b2c code=502 conn=reset
[09:11:03] WARN batching: request window queued=128 -> 512
```

Marta - SRE: That queuing pattern + canary rollout timing makes me suspect a regression in the canary that reduces worker concurrency under certain prompt shapes. Rolling a rollback check now.

AcmeOps - Customer: We can repro reliably with a ~6k token prompt and 3 concurrent clients. Happy to share the exact prompt offline. Severity: blocking for our nightly job.

Jin - Runtime: Confirmed: canary change to the attention kernel introduced an extra mutex during KV fetch. Under large prompt sizes and 3+ concurrency this serialized access and caused queue amplification -> upstream timeouts + 502s.

Marta - SRE: Action plan:
- abort canary rollout immediately (in progress)
- scale up replica pool by +30% to drain backlog
- temporarily set SDK-oriented mitigation: recommend customer set `max_concurrency=2` or use smaller batches
- postmortem if rollback is necessary

Ravi - Support: Communicated mitigation to AcmeOps: asked them to throttle to 2 concurrent requests and confirm if that unblocks. Also offered temporary Dedicated burst pool while we revert.

AcmeOps - Customer: throttling to 2 reduced errors immediately, P95 back to ~700ms. Thanks — please keep us posted on rollback ETA.

Marta - SRE: Canary aborted at 09:26 UTC and new canary candidate pinned for further tests. Rolling rollback to previous runtime build; watching metrics.

Jin - Runtime: Patch ready to remove the mutex in attention path and replace with reader-friendly lock. Will cut a hotfix and coordinate with SRE for canary tomorrow if prod stable.

Ravi - Support: Noted. Customer updated and left on a short-term throttle. I'll follow up with timeline for hotfix and PM/postmortem link. :thumbsup:
